steps.name: Samurai
steps.text: Your Majesty, Shogun! You're finally back!

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: How fares the fight?

steps.name: Samurai
steps.text: The wild beasts are ceaselessly rushing forth from the Gyorin! We... We are completely overwhelmed!

steps.name: Samurai
steps.text: The defensive line constructed by the shogun over the past few years has proven useful, but I fear it is only a matter of time before it is breached.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: ...Good work. Relay the order to hold on for just a while longer—the defense line cannot fall. Her Majesty and I will figure something out.

steps.name: Samurai
steps.text: Yes, sir! We have no doubt you will!

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Bold words. What if we fail to come up with a plan?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Morale is essential for teamwork. Trust trumps every other factor on the battlefield.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Yet honeyed words do not win wars. A purely defensive strategy will only have us wasting lives to delay the inevitable.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: The Lord of Thunder now leads the horde. Catapult hath the right of it: slaying it remains the best choice for us to ensure the capital's safety.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: I do understand your sentiment, Your Majesty.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: But the beasts have the upper hand in numbers, and we must prioritize the most immediate problems.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: I shall personally lead our forces to quell the beasts. Even should I die, what end could be more fitting for a kingdom of hunters?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: You mustn't.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Even should you slay dozens, nay, a hundred beasts, our scouts have reported their numbers have yet to dwindle.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: May I take it thou hast another plan in mind, then?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: ...First, I must offer a grim assessment: Houei cannot best this torrent of beasts with the forces we have.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Had I another thirty years to prepare, perhaps I could have built an army capable of doing so.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: I am well aware that a direct confrontation would be fruitless.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Precisely. We must take the initiative and separate their forces.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: But how? Our forces are stretched thin as it is. Now you're planning to split them up even more?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: I understand your concern. Which is why this battle must be won not with might, but with wits. We have... one-of-a-kind bait up our sleeve.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: What do you mean, bait?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: The 'Iju' Escorchgot we defeated. Or rather, its corpse.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: How does that help?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: You have both seen the curse at work.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: It is a most unusual power, and affected beasts will be instinctively drawn to stronger sources of it, like moths to a flame.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: But didn't Hofukaru already absorb its curse?

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Only enough to activate the Gyorin. Its curse has yet to fade completely.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Which makes it currently nothing more than a tantalizing feast for the corrupted beasts.

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: Using what you've caught to lure in more. I see you're getting the hang of meowsnter hunting techniques.

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: But where do we lead them to? It'd be impawssible to outrun the beasts on the plains.
Midnight's finger points to a long stretch of land on the map. A bamboo grove outside the city.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Several miles east of the city is an enormous cavity beneath the grove. All that remains of an ancient river.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: You mean...

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Yes, we'll dispatch an elite squad to serve as bait, using the Iju's corpse to draw the horde to the grove. Then...

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: With Suponosuke's bombs, we will blow up the terrain beneath their feet, sending the beasts to fall to their deaths.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: A sound plan on the surface, but... why am I only now learning of such peculiar geography?

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: That's where...

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: Pawse! Isn't that where the former lord—

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Indeed, that cavity is the lair of the Lord of Thunder.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Which is precisely why Your Majesty has never managed to locate the beast's den.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Had it not been for the pressing situation we are in, I would never have divulged it.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Then I shall go myself.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: It was I who hunted the Iju, and its curse resonates with my power as a miko. No one is better suited to use it as a lure.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Forgive me, Your Majesty... but I cannot allow this.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Midnight! I may be a ruler, but do not forget I am also one of Houei's strongest hunters!

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Or dost thou still think me foolish enough to recklessly challenge the Lord of Thunder?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Whatever else it has done this past decade, it has never brought ruin upon us.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: In a sense, it has even granted us a period of peace.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: You may see this peace as a humiliation, but I am willing to die to protect it. Think me a coward if you wish.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: I only hope you can trust that all I have done has been to pave a path for you to one day slay the Lord of Thunder.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: But today, it remains unclear how exactly the Lord of Thunder has triggered these changes.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Now is not the time.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: How many times must I endure this same speech? When will it ever be 'the time'?

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Why dost thou insist on arranging the course of my life?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: ...Because I have seen things you have not.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Your Majesty, your presence in the capital would do wonders for our citizens' morale.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Houei needs you.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: The same as ever, then.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Orchid, I ask that you stay in the city and aid Her Majesty.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: I don't need you to tell me that.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: But are you sure you'll be able to blow a hole in the ground? If your plan fails, the squad acting as bait will be torn to shreds.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: I believe in Suponosuke.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Lemme help too!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: She is one of the best soldiers we have at the moment. Take her with you, and Yoshitsune too. They'll follow your orders.

spans.text: one of the best soldiers we have at the moment. Take her with you, and Yoshitsune too. They'll follow your orders.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Got it!

steps.name: Yoshitsune
steps.text: (Excited howling)

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Masamune, you stay here with me, and we'll help Her Majesty protect the capital.

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: No pawblem! I'll keep my eyes on Her Meowjesty!

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Midnight.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Yes?

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: ...Return alive.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Right.

steps.name: Suponosuke
steps.text: Uh, Your Majesty, I know you're feeling upset.

steps.name: Suponosuke
steps.text: But could you refrain from pacing around in my home?

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: I find myself restless, waiting in the palace.

steps.name: Suponosuke
steps.text: And being in my house is somehow therapeutic?!

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Thou hast formed a rapport with Midnight. Seeing thee raises my spirits.

steps.name: Suponosuke
steps.text: Rapport? With that guy? Hardly.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: I was wondering about that too. Why are you of all people the only one close enough to the shogun to joke around with him?

steps.name: Suponosuke
steps.text: You're here too?! Is my house a tourist attraction now?!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: I couldn't wait in the palace either. And this is the only other place I've been to.

steps.name: Suponosuke
steps.text: Tch.

steps.name: Suponosuke
steps.text: Ten years back, I was still an apprentice. And that guy was just a bug scurrying after the former lord.

steps.name: Suponosuke
steps.text: My master joined the expedition team, and got killed by cursed beasts. The former lord vanished soon after.

steps.name: Suponosuke
steps.text: From then on, the shogun would occasionally come calling, saying we were in the same boat. Hmph. Not sure I'd agree.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: You don't hate the Lord of Thunder?

steps.name: Suponosuke
steps.text: Hate, huh? I mean, that monster is why I'm always inventing new equipment. One day, someone will use my weapons to slay it.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: So you're actually serious about your job.

steps.name: Suponosuke
steps.text: Did I ever say I wasn't? Well, I can see why people might not think so.

steps.name: Suponosuke
steps.text: Midnight's the only one who's been encouraging me to never give up. But even so, there's nothing I can do to help him in return. So I wouldn't really count us friends.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: That's not what it means to be friends.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Come on, Hofukaru. Standing around here won't solve anything.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Let's see if there's anyone outside who needs our help.
